text: A special case: apomixis. A seed forms without any fertilization, so the embryo is a clone of its mother. In citrus and mango, extra embryos grow out of the nucellus beside the normal one: nucellar polyembryony. Breeders love apomixis, because it could fix a hybrid's vigour for ever.
